explanation: Differentiating gives f'(x)=3x^{1/2}-6x^{-1/2}+3x^{-3/2}=3(x-1)^2/x^{3/2}. Also, f''(x)=(3/2)x^{-1/2}+3x^{-3/2}-(9/2)x^{-5/2}, so f''(1)=0. Since f'(x)>0 on both sides of x=1, the function increases through this point and has neither a relative minimum nor a relative maximum. Only statement I is true.
